ai_llms.summary: ChatGPT can now generate interactive interfaces and task-specific tools instead of only text. Paid tiers get GPT-6 Sol first, and Free and Go users get GPT-6 Luna the next day.
ai_llms.title: OpenAI rolls out GPT-6 with Intelligent UI, free tiers follow a day later

ai_llms.summary: Anthropic released Claude Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 on October 21. It says Opus 5.5 leads in agentic coding and knowledge work at 40% lower cost than Opus 5, and Sonnet 5.5 is over 30% faster and up to 30% cheaper.
ai_llms.title: Anthropic launches Claude Opus, Sonnet and Haiku 5.5, with Opus 40% cheaper to run

ai_llms.summary: Mistral Large 4 is a multimodal mixture-of-experts model with about 1T total and 49–52B active parameters. A public-preview API is live at about $1.36/$4.18 per million input/output tokens, with weights expected later in October.
ai_llms.title: Mistral previews Large 4, a ~1T-parameter open-weight multimodal MoE

ai_llms.summary: Anthropic announced on October 22 that it is donating Agent Skills, its open standard for giving agents specialized knowledge and repeatable workflows, to the Agentic AI Foundation.
ai_llms.title: Anthropic donates Agent Skills to the Agentic AI Foundation

data_science_ml.summary: NTU researchers introduced LACE in Nature Machine Intelligence, an LLM-driven system that builds portfolios of specialized heuristics. On four new maritime routing problems it reached 97–99% of the best tested result in about an hour at roughly US$10.
data_science_ml.title: LACE builds near-best optimization heuristics in about an hour for ~$10

data_science_ml.summary: The Swiss AI team released Apertus 1.5 (8B and 70B) with image and audio understanding, an optional thinking mode, 4x longer context and stronger tool use under Apache 2.0, with base, SFT, RLVR and DPO checkpoints and training datasets on Hugging Face. The 8B model reportedly matches GPT-OSS-20B on the Last Translation Benchmark and beats Claude Haiku 4.5 and Google Translate.
data_science_ml.title: Apertus 1.5 adds multimodality and reasoning to Apache-2.0 8B and 70B models

data_science_ml.summary: DeepSeek released the V4.1-Flash-1017 checkpoint on October 17, with gains on Terminal-Bench 4.0 (+11.1), ProgramBench (+8.8), Apex Bench (+7.5) and DeepSWE v1.1 (+2.8). API pricing is reportedly unchanged and the license is MIT.
data_science_ml.title: DeepSeek V4.1-Flash-1017 lifts Terminal-Bench 4.0 from 31.2 to 42.3 under MIT license

data_science_ml.summary: The benchmark pairs 1,800 flawed requests, covering four types of premise error, with their valid originals and tests three prompting settings. Frontier systems usually trust the premise and generate SQL rather than challenge the request or abstain.
data_science_ml.title: PremiseSQL shows frontier text-to-SQL models accept flawed requests instead of pushing back

data_science_ml.summary: FrontiersMind released Lumma-Fev-27B under Apache 2.0, a Qwen3.8-27B-based model that scores options in one forward pass. On 4,454 held-out decisions it reached 90.7% accuracy against 83.9% for Jev, with better-calibrated confidence.
data_science_ml.title: Lumma-Fev-27B beats Jev on decision accuracy, 90.7% vs 83.9%

data_science_ml.summary: Thousands of GPT-Rosalind-powered agents analyzed existing data from millions of mouse brain cells in 32 minutes. The leads they generate still need experimental validation.
data_science_ml.title: OpenAI, PerturbAI and Scripps run thousands of agents over millions of brain cells in 32 minutes

data_science_ml.summary: NVIDIA published Kumo Relational, a Relational Graph Transformer for multi-table data, which reportedly beat XGBoost pipelines on 41 tasks across 15 databases. The library is Apache 2.0 but the weights use the more restrictive OpenMDW license.
data_science_ml.title: NVIDIA releases Kumo Relational, beating XGBoost on 41 relational tasks without feature engineering

explainers.summary: CVA prices the risk that a derivatives counterparty defaults before a trade matures, and banks must hold regulatory capital against swings in it.
explainers.title: Credit valuation adjustment (CVA) and its capital charge

explainers.summary: A forward FX rate is pinned to spot by the interest-rate gap between two currencies, so curbs on derivatives also affect spot pressure and hedging costs.
explainers.title: Covered interest parity: why FX forwards tie to the spot rate

explainers.summary: Futures and swap prices embed an expected policy rate, and dividing the gap to the current rate by the size of one hike gives a probability, with caveats about risk premia.
explainers.title: How a market-implied rate-hike probability is computed

explainers.summary: NDFs are cash-settled FX forwards on restricted currencies, traded offshore, which is why regulators target them when defending a currency.
explainers.title: Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs)

explainers.summary: When a supplier funds its own customer, who spends the money on the supplier's products, reported demand depends on the supplier's own capital and risk becomes correlated across both firms.
explainers.title: Circular (vendor) financing

explainers.summary: Scores on terminal and coding-agent benchmarks reflect the model plus its scaffold, tools and limits, so numbers from different reports are often not directly comparable.
explainers.title: Why agent benchmark scores depend on the harness

explainers.summary: A model that can decline to answer trades coverage (how many queries it answers) for risk (error rate on those it answers), which is why text-to-SQL needs premise checks.
explainers.title: Abstention and the risk–coverage trade-off

explainers.summary: A repo is a secured loan made by selling a security with an agreement to buy it back, and haircuts on the collateral can rise in stress, forcing deleveraging.
explainers.title: Repo: secured funding, haircuts and collateral stress

explainers.summary: Banks hold large amounts of their own government's debt, so falling bond prices weaken the banks, and weaker banks raise the state's risk, which pushes bond prices down further.
explainers.title: The bank–sovereign doom loop

explainers.summary: A model is calibrated when its stated confidence matches its actual hit rate, which is measured separately from accuracy and can be adjusted after training.
explainers.title: Calibration and expected calibration error

explainers.summary: Joining and aggregating multi-table data into one row per entity discards structure that graph-based models over rows and foreign keys can use directly.
explainers.title: Why flattening relational tables loses information

quant_finance.summary: The US 10-year yield briefly hit 5.364%, a 24-year high, and the 30-year auction cleared at its highest yield since 2000. The French–German 10-year spread passed 140 bp, the widest since 2012, the euro fell to $1.1161 and Brent rose above $104.
quant_finance.title: US 10-year yield hits 24-year high as French–German spread passes 140 bp

quant_finance.summary: UniCredit's credit valuation adjustment risk-weighted assets doubled, which the bank attributes to strategic transactions tied to building its Commerzbank stake.
quant_finance.title: UniCredit's CVA risk-weighted assets double during Commerzbank stake build-up

quant_finance.summary: On October 10 the RBI introduced a dollar liquidity window for state-owned oil refiners and a reserve requirement on FX derivatives as the rupee neared a record low. It had raised rates on October 7 and signalled more tightening was possible.
quant_finance.title: RBI adds oil-refiner dollar window and FX-derivatives reserve requirement

quant_finance.summary: Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia pushed Brent above $105.50 before it reversed to about $104.15. Markets price an 18% chance of a Fed hike this month and 85% for December.
quant_finance.title: Houthi strikes on Saudi Arabia spike Brent past $105; December Fed hike now 85% priced

quant_finance.summary: Strategists expect South Korea's 3- and 10-year bonds to retest last month's four-year-high yields. Won swaps price about a 70% chance of 50 bp of cumulative BoK hikes over six months.
quant_finance.title: Won swaps price a 70% chance of 50 bp in Bank of Korea hikes

quant_finance.summary: The RBI requires banks to deposit cash equal to 20% of the rupee notional of qualifying FX derivative contracts, now including banks' own hedges, and limited non-resident NDFs to hedging. SBI estimates the measures could drain over ₹1 trillion from the banking system, and banks are lobbying for a client fee instead.
quant_finance.title: RBI's 20% cash reserve on rupee FX derivatives extends to banks' own hedges; banks warn of ₹1 trillion drain

quant_finance.summary: The IMF's Global Financial Stability Report reviewed 14 AI transactions since 2023 involving about $300B of equity and $650B of debt, exchanged for $1.4T of future revenue commitments. It warns an AI slowdown could trigger a leverage-amplified correction.
quant_finance.title: IMF flags leveraged, circular AI financing as a correction trigger

quant_finance.summary: On October 16 the Nikkei rose 1.9% after almost 5% fall and the KOSPI rose 3.3% after an almost 8% drop, following renewed concern over CoreWeave's debt load and AI-boom financing. US Nasdaq and S&P 500 futures were up 0.2% early.
quant_finance.title: Nikkei and KOSPI rebound after near-5% and near-8% drops on AI-financing worries

quant_finance.summary: On October 19 the Nikkei fell 1.2% and Korea 0.4% after weekly losses of 5.4% and over 14%. The 10-year Treasury yield dropped 4 bp to 5.0525% as oil fell on a possible US sanctions waiver for Russian fuel.
quant_finance.title: Asian equities fall again on AI-funding worries as oil slide lifts Treasuries

quant_finance.summary: Risk.net reports exposures at 29 European banks rose 14% to €881 billion, with 18 banks at all-time highs. The rise was driven by larger repo and securities-lending positions, especially at German banks.
quant_finance.title: European banks' securities-financing exposure hits record €881B

quant_finance.summary: France's 10-year government bond yield touched 5% on October 21, the highest since 2002, amid protests and doubts over fiscal repair. Brent rose above $110 and US Treasury yields also rose.
quant_finance.title: France's 10-year yield touches 5%, highest since 2002, as Brent rebounds above $110

quant_finance.summary: France's 10-year yield is above 5% and its spread over Germany reached 165 bp, the widest since 2011, on stalled budget talks and downgrade risk. European equity futures fell 0.7%.
quant_finance.title: French–German 10-year spread widens to 165 bp, widest since 2011

quant_finance.summary: Brent rose about 3% to above $112, its highest since May. Nasdaq 100 futures fell 1.8% and S&P 500 futures 1%, putting the Nasdaq 100's 2.2% weekly gain at risk.
quant_finance.title: Brent above $112, highest since May, as Nasdaq 100 futures fall 1.8%

quant_finance.summary: The Nasdaq Composite fell 2.6%, erasing about $1T, and the SOX fell 6.7%, while the 10-year Treasury yield dropped over 19 bp to 4.9591%. Goldman data show several hedge-fund strategy groups each lost over 1% on October 22.
quant_finance.title: Nasdaq falls 2.6% and 10-year yield drops 19 bp as AI-funding fears hit hedge funds

scandinavian_tech.summary: Copenhagen-based Seed Capital raised a €130M fifth fund to back 15–17 startups with €3–6M initial cheques. It will invest outside Denmark for the first time, with a focus on Sweden, and adds cybersecurity.
scandinavian_tech.title: Seed Capital closes €130M Fund V and expands to Sweden

scandinavian_tech.summary: Swedish ocean-energy company Minesto was selected for a €20.2M EU Innovation Fund grant for its proposed Euro Dragon Farm project. Grant-agreement preparation began on 19 October.
scandinavian_tech.title: Minesto selected for €20.2M EU Innovation Fund grant
